title: Cobweb Utilities
description: This datapack adds more crafts with wool & strings
body:
This proyect is a cobweb-related datapack, with five new crafts: Cobwebs, strings, wool (diferent). If you like more crafts I'm sure this datapack likes you.

If this project reaches 100 downloads, I will make another version (for 1.20.1 and another version (1.0.1)).
